prompt: Whose baseball sports cards have been sold for over a million dollars the most times? For the same card, only the highest sale value is counted.
answer: **Mickey Mantle**—his cards have recorded **23 distinct sales above $1 million**, counting only the highest sale for each card. He leads Honus Wagner (19) and Babe Ruth (13).
